what: The same, checked against the Python-written data file

name: valid/analyses/data_file_at_a_url
what: The hint to the data file is a URL

name: valid/analyses/data_file_beside_the_analysis
what: The hint to the data file is a relative path

name: valid/analyses/fits_from_two_jobs
what: The fit cache was filled by two jobs, and one response is in both parts

name: valid/analyses/fits_formula_spaced_differently
what: A part of the fit cache records the analysis's formula with other spacing; its fits are used

name: valid/analyses/fits_made_with_another_method
what: The one part of the fit cache was made with a method other than the analysis's: allowed, and a reader takes no fit from it

name: valid/analyses/stale_part_beside_a_current_one
what: Beside the current part is one left by an earlier QC, made for other cells: allowed, and a reader given the current identity reads the current part only

name: valid/analyses/testing_stage_cleared_fits_kept
what: The calibration stage was cleared for a rerun; the fit cache remains

name: valid/analyses/stage_written_in_another_language
what: A stage written by an implementation in a third language

name: valid/analyses/tables_in_parts
what: A table as a folder of parts, with dictionary-encoded identifiers, an unknown column, and an unknown file beside it

name: invalid/analyses/no_analysis_json
what: `analysis.json` is missing

name: invalid/analyses/no_response_modality
what: `analysis.json` does not name a response modality

name: invalid/analyses/response_modality_grna
what: `analysis.json` names `grna` as the response modality

name: invalid/analyses/response_modality_not_in_file
what: The response modality is `protein`, which the data file does not have

name: valid/analyses/covariates_brought_by_the_analysis
what: The data file stores no count summaries; the analysis brings them, and a computed label, in its own covariate table

name: invalid/analyses/covariate_the_data_file_already_has
what: The analysis brings covariates under names the data file already provides

name: invalid/analyses/formula_names_an_unknown_covariate
what: The formula names count summaries that neither the data file nor the analysis provides

name: invalid/analyses/covariate_of_the_wrong_type
what: A covariate the analysis brings is a boolean, not a number or text

name: invalid/analyses/covariates_for_some_cells_only
what: The analysis's covariate table lacks some cells of the data file

name: invalid/analyses/analysis_format_from_the_future
what: The analysis's format version is 9.0

name: invalid/analyses/absolute_path_to_the_data
what: The hint to the data file is an absolute local path

name: invalid/analyses/another_dataset
what: The dataset identifier is that of another data file; the parts of the fit cache are then another dataset's, which is allowed and unused

name: invalid/analyses/record_of_another_stage
what: The record in `discovery/` says it is the record of the power stage

name: invalid/analyses/side_up
what: The parameters record has `side` set to `up`

name: invalid/analyses/moi_medium
what: The parameters record has `moi` set to `medium`

name: invalid/analyses/no_seed
what: The parameters record has no `seed`

name: invalid/analyses/stage_without_its_predecessor
what: The assignment record is missing while later stages remain

name: invalid/analyses/listed_file_missing
what: A table that a record lists is not in the folder

name: invalid/analyses/table_truncated
what: `cells.parquet` has fewer rows than its stage wrote

name: invalid/analyses/table_listed_outside_the_stage_folder
what: A record lists a table by a path that leaves the stage's folder

name: invalid/analyses/required_table_not_listed
what: The QC record does not list `cells.parquet`, which is still in the folder

name: invalid/analyses/stale_results
what: The discovery record is gone and its results table remains

name: invalid/analyses/column_missing
what: `cells.parquet` has no `in_use` column

name: invalid/analyses/column_of_the_wrong_type
what: `pass_qc` is stored as integers

name: invalid/analyses/rows_not_sorted
what: The assignment table is in reverse order

name: invalid/analyses/duplicate_row
what: The assignment table has the same (gRNA, cell) twice

name: invalid/analyses/cell_not_in_the_data_file
what: The assignment table names a cell the data file does not have

name: invalid/analyses/grna_column_under_the_union_strategy
what: A pair-QC table has a `grna_id` column in an analysis that pools gRNAs by target

name: invalid/analyses/grna_column_in_bonferroni_discovery
what: The discovery results of a bonferroni analysis have a `grna_id` column

name: invalid/analyses/significant_stored
what: The discovery results store a `significant` column

name: invalid/analyses/no_log_2_fold_change
what: The discovery results have no `log_2_fold_change` (T5.1)

name: invalid/analyses/effect_sizes_disagree
what: A `log_2_fold_change` is not the base-2 logarithm of the row's `fold_change`

name: invalid/analyses/fit_part_without_identity
what: A part of the fit cache does not say how its fits were made, as after a tool rewrote it; a reader takes no fit from it

name: invalid/analyses/fit_identity_incomplete
what: The identity inside a part of the fit cache lacks `cells_in_use_sha256`

name: invalid/analyses/fit_identity_not_json
what: The identity inside a part of the fit cache is not JSON

name: invalid/analyses/identity_file_in_the_fit_cache
what: The fit cache holds a JSON file beside its parts, which a folder reader would trip on

name: invalid/analyses/fits_before_qc
what: An analysis that stopped after assignment holds a fit cache

name: invalid/analyses/fit_with_too_few_coefficients
what: A saved fit has fewer coefficients than the design has terms

name: invalid/analyses/formula_with_an_interaction
what: The formula has an interaction, outside the additive subset; the fit cache was made for another formula, which is allowed and unused
